meta.host: reference host — Intel i9-12900F, 24 threads, 30 MiB L3, Ubuntu 22.04 / kernel 6.8
meta.method: benches/bench_memtable.cc built -O3 against release libexpanse.so; median of 3 back-to-back runs on an idle host (load < 0.4)
meta.retraction_372: The skiplist arm of the commit-7d87dff7 run used a strawman Node embedding all 16 tower pointers statically (~146.7 B/entry); that density figure and the derived 11.1x headline are retracted (#372). ram_bytes_per_key.skiplist below is re-measured with the fair variable-height node (8 B key ptr + height*8 B tower, E[height]=4/3): deterministic seeded byte accounting, load-immune, reproduced twice (Apple M1, 8 cores, Apple clang 21, -O3, at the #372 fix commit; expanse/vector cells reproduce the 7d87dff7 values byte-for-byte). The wall-clock cells (sequential_scan_mops, readrandom_ns) are still the commit-7d87dff7 measurements taken against the retracted strawman baseline — the skiplist arms are pending a quiet-host re-run with the fair node layout.
